name: amnitex
description: Lossless local byte-page memory for MCP assistants in native Gold/Helium.
long_description: AmniTex persists project knowledge and conversation turns into a local, lossless byte-page key-value store (.atex) indexed by a 2D spatial TexGrid in native Gold/Helium. Retrieves exact code, rules, and prior turn facts through an exact-match nonce texture LUT, without loss.

tools.name: atex_search
tools.description: Search the local atex knowledge base (spatial tex-grid) for entries matching a query.

tools.name: atex_where
tools.description: Find which files hold something: file keys, line numbers, and one best line each.

tools.name: atex_recall
tools.description: Exact-key lookup in the atex knowledge base, optionally only the lines matching a query.

tools.name: atex_remember
tools.description: Persist a learned fact to the atex knowledge base under namespace manual::.

tools.name: atex_list_keys
tools.description: List keys in the atex KB matching a prefix.

tools.name: atex_stats
tools.description: Get atex KB statistics and unbiased context tracker report path.

atex_dir.title: Knowledge Base Directory (.atex)
atex_dir.description: Optional path to your .atex directory. Defaults to ~/.atex if blank.
